name: check_room
description: Check whether a room is available for a requested time interval. Give start, end, and now as whole minutes since midnight, from 0 to 1440; for example, 10:00 is 600 and 24:00 is 1440. Set blocked to true if the room cannot be used. List existing bookings as start and end minute values. This tool only checks availability and does not create or save a booking.

start.description: Requested start time in whole minutes since midnight.

end.description: Requested end time in whole minutes since midnight.

now.description: Current time in whole minutes since midnight.

blocked.description: Whether the room is blocked and cannot be used.

bookings.description: Existing bookings, each with start and end in whole minutes since midnight.
